typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MASTER_SSN as string,
		RECIPIENT_SSN as string,
		DEDUCTION_AMT as integer,
		ACTUAL_AMOUNT as integer,
		DEDUCTION_STAT_CD as string,
		GROUP_ID as string,
		BGBG_ID as string,
		BILLFROMDATE as timestamp,
		BILLTODATE as timestamp,
		INVOICENUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  MASTER_SSN, RECIPIENT_SSN, DEDUCTION_AMT, ACTUAL_AMOUNT, DEDUCTION_STAT_CD, GROUP_ID, BGBG_ID, BILLFROMDATE, BILLTODATE, INVOICENUMBER from AGP.GRS_MEABT_PENSION_REPORT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of INVOICENUMBER} = toString(INVOICENUMBER),
		{Copy of BILLTODATE} = toString(BILLTODATE),
		{Copy of ACTUAL_AMOUNT} = toString(ACTUAL_AMOUNT),
		{Copy of MASTER_SSN} = toString(MASTER_SSN),
		{Copy of RECIPIENT_SSN} = toString(RECIPIENT_SSN),
		{Copy of BILLFROMDATE} = toString(BILLFROMDATE),
		{Copy of DEDUCTION_STAT_CD} = toString(DEDUCTION_STAT_CD),
		{Copy of BGBG_ID} = toString(BGBG_ID),
		{Copy of GROUP_ID} = toString(GROUP_ID),
		{Copy of DEDUCTION_AMT} = toString(DEDUCTION_AMT)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
